<subject>Meridian Law & Advisory LLP?</subject>
<body>
Antony,

Meridian Law & Advisory LLP, on behalf of the High Court, will be soliciting proposals for advisory services. We are currently contemplating limited engagement, and would like to get a Master Services Agreement (MSA) in place. We would like to do a quick follow up in regards to the status of the MSA contract between yourselves and the High Court. If your legal department has any questions or concerns, please contact Dale Fletcher of Meridian Law & Advisory LLP at +44 7817 646361.

To address any credit concerns you may have, the department is currently preparing a complete financial package which we will forward to you upon its completion.

Again, please do not hesitate to call.

Thank You,
Judith Dennis
Contract Administration
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP
+44 7817 646361
